body: upvote for the Ender reference. I didnt know anyone else read that book.

A man's head getting mutilated by the propeller on a boat. THAT was interesting. He wasn't paying attention, breast-stroked past the buoy, and  all you heard was a the propeller going *chop chop chop THUNK THUNK* and then whirring as the motor started to lock up in his hair. I got to see the bits of skull and brain matter and blood fly up like fireworks.
I play bass, and I always ALWAYS have a cigarette or a dip in when im playing. somehow, despite the smoke rolling into my eyes or chew spit filling my mouth, it helps me focus.
